evidence: Modifies shared argument parsing infrastructure in src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and node initialization in src/init.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a systemic configuration parsing flaw where negated options default to "0", causing node assertion crashes, filesystem aborts, and severe configuration surprises. The PR description notes that '-nolimitclustercount hits an assertion in TxGraph on the first mempool transaction' and '-norpcpassword sets the password to 0 instead of using cookie authentication.' Resolving these unpredictable behaviors provides substantial, durable stability and predictability to argument handling across the entire node.
